blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—Trial Chamber (TC) III Judge Joanna Korner of the International Criminal Court chided the defense team of former President Rodrigo Duterte for its purported refusal to cooperate with the prosecution. This pertains to the prosecution panel’s active proposals to reduce evidentiary clutter and volume of legal documents. The proposeals were presented during the fourth status conference of the International Criminal Court’s (ICC) TC III. There was a discussion on handling a massive data set containing official records from the Philippine National Police (PNP), government accomplishment reports, and documentation on the deaths during Duterte’s “war on drugs.” Senior Trial Lawyer Julian […]...
